records.footnote: Data pertain to residents (i.e. Singapore citizens and permanent residents) who were not attending educational institutions as full-time students and include those who were not upgrading their qualifications through part-time courses. For more information, please refer to the 'Population Trends' publication (https://www.singstat.gov.sg/publication-resources/population-trends-2025).  Data for 2000, 2010 and 2020 are based on the Census of Population while data for 2005, 2015 and 2025 are based on the General Household Survey. Data for all other years are based on the Comprehensive June Labour Force Survey.  Survey estimates are subject to sampling variability.  Tertiary refers to diploma, professional and university qualifications.
